story.page_1:
Alice was leaning against a tree, trying to play cards with her little kitten, Dinah.

'Well', Alice thought boredly, 'playing alone isn't nearly as fun anymore'.

She watched her cat playing with the pile of cards using her little paws.

'I wanted something new, different, and... someone unpredictable' she says aloud.
story.page_2:
The gentle breeze soon made Alice drowsy. Her eyelids grew heavier until, before she even realized it, she had drifted into a deep sleep.

...

'Alice? Alice?'

A familiar voice echoed nearby. Slowly, Alice opened her eyes.

She looked around in confusion. Stone walls surrounded her, and a long tunnel stretched ahead.

'A rabbit hole?'
story.page_3:
'How did I get here? Where's Dinah?' Alice asked.

The White Queen hurried toward her, almost tripping over her own dress.

'Oh, I'm so relieved I found you!'

'White Queen? What's going on?'

'I've come with a very important invitation... from the Queen of Hearts'

Alice froze.

'The Queen of Hearts? Now THAT sounds unpredictable.'
story.page_4:
The White Queen glanced nervously over her shoulder.

'She insists that everyone in Wonderland participate in a card tournament.'

'Wait, a card tournament?' Alice asked.

'Yes! She's grown tired of cricket...' the Queen whispered.

The White Queen forced a smile.

'If you refuse... she'll blame me for failing to deliver the invitation.'
story.page_5:
Alice smiled while her eyes sparkled with excitement.

'That's exactly what I was hoping for. Count me in!'

The White Queen sighed with relief.

'Wonderful! Before you leave... the Queen has grown even more merciless lately.'

[b]'Would you like to play with me so I can teach you?'[/b]

tutorial.page_1:
[u][b]Chapter 1[/b][/u]

[b]The Goal[/b]

The goal of the game is to win two rounds by reaching 21 with numeric cards or get as close as possible.
tutorial.page_2:
[u][b]Chapter 2[/b][/u]

[b]The Turn[/b]

On your turn, you can draw a numeric card or draw/play a Power Card, which grants you abilities during matches.
tutorial.page_3:
[u][b]Chapter 3[/b][/u]

[b]The Relics[/b]

After finishing a match, you choose a relic that will passively help you for the rest of the game.
tutorial.page_4:
[u][b]Chapter 4[/b][/u]

[b]The Loser[/b]

You lose the round if the total value of your cards exceeds 21, or if your opponent obtains a higher sum than yours.
tutorial.page_5:
[u][b]Chapter 5[/b][/u]

[b]The Tie[/b]

When there's a tie or both players exceed 21, no point is awarded, and a new round starts.

white_queen.1: So Alice, this is different version from the classic ''21'' or blackjack card game.
white_queen.2: The goal is the same, try to reach [b]21[/b] by drawing numeric cards from that [color=#005eff]blue[/color] deck on your right.
white_queen.3: But don't worry too much if you can't get exactly [b]21[/b]. It's hard, since you don't know the next number you're gonna draw from the deck.
white_queen.4: Just avoid exceeding [b]21[/b], or you'll lose the round. The [color=#005eff]blue[/color] deck contain [b]12[/b] cards from [b]1 up to 12[/b].
white_queen.5: In Wonderjack everyone starts a new round drawing the [b]first[/b] hidden card. Only the owner can see it's number, and the opponent can only guess what is.
white_queen.6: For you see your hidden card, just hover the mouse on it.
white_queen.7: On your turn, you can do only one of 4 possible actions: [b]draw a number[/b], [b]stop[/b], [b]draw a power[/b] or [b]play a power[/b].
white_queen.8: To draw a number, click on the [color=#005eff]blue[/color] deck. That makes you draw the top card from the deck.
white_queen.9: To stop, click on the bell. That makes you finish this round and the opponent can only do 1 more action before we check our numbers.
white_queen.10: When the round finishes, all hidden number cards are revealed and the numbers are counted to see who reached [b]21[/b] or closest to it. If both players pass 21, nobody wins the round.
white_queen.11: For the first round, let's ignore the deck on the left to make things simple.
white_queen.13: Well, I'm not drawing anymore cards. So I'll stop!
white_queen.14: Fantastic! You won the first round Alice.
white_queen.15: When you win a round, a [color=#005eff]blue[/color] flame lights up on the candlestick.
white_queen.16: But when you opponent wins, a [color=#ff0000]red[/color] flame lights up.
white_queen.17: The first player to win 2 rounds is the winner of the match!
white_queen.18: Now lets focus that special deck on your left to use some [color=#ffff00]power[/color] cards this time.
white_queen.19: On your turn, you can also either [b]draw[/b] or [b]play[/b] a power card that you already have in your hand.
white_queen.20: To draw one, just click on the [color=#ffff00]yellow[/color] deck on your left. And to play a power card, just hover your mouse and drag up and drop on your screen.
white_queen.21: Every player can only draw 2 power card in each round by default.
white_queen.22: Not to mention that you can hold only 2 power cards at the same time.
white_queen.23: These cards stay with you between rounds, so use them wisely!
white_queen.24: Just remember that I can also do the same. *wink*
white_queen.26: Don't get angry with me Alice, but I need to play this power...
white_queen.28: Don't worry Alice, sometimes the power cards can't help much, but keeping them to the next round might be the best strategy.
white_queen.29: Now, it's the final round of this match. Do your best!
white_queen.30: Oh! It seems that I've won again.
white_queen.31: Usually, when that happens, you lost the game and you should try again from the beginning.
white_queen.32: But since I'm just teaching you, I think you're ready to find the others and learn with them.
white_queen.33: Look at you, you've won this match!
white_queen.34: But don't get too confident, the others out there have different playstyles and are much more chaotic.
white_queen.35: Anyway, I think you're ready to find more challenging players...
white_queen.36: Also, after each future match you win, there'll be special rewards for you to choose from.
white_queen.37: I won't spoil the surprise. Try to find out!
white_queen.38: Good luck Alice, I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you.
white_queen.block_stop: Alice, draw more numbers cards before trying to stop this round.
white_queen.tip_stop: If you're close to [b]21[/b], it's better to stop and avoid risks. Press the bell to stop this round.
white_queen.tip_stop2: If your sum is 21 or more, it's better not draw number cards and stop the round.
white_queen.tip_power: Think again Alice, playing this power wouldn't be smart.
white_queen.tip_power2: Why don't you try drawing a power card from the deck on your left?

Mad Hatter.name: Mad Hatter
Mad Hatter.talk_lose: I tip my hat to you.
Mad Hatter.talk_thinking_1: I need to finish this game because it's almost tea time!
Mad Hatter.talk_thinking_2: I’d love to offer you a cup of tea, but my hands are full.
Mad Hatter.talk_thinking_3: Why is a raven like a writing-desk? — I haven’t the slightest idea.
Mad Hatter.special: What if my the next card is hidden?

March Hare.name: March Hare
March Hare.talk_win: Are you leaving already? You haven't even had a cup of tea!
March Hare.talk_lose: Well, I guess tea time is over!
March Hare.talk_thinking_1: I’d offer you some wine if I had any...
March Hare.talk_thinking_2: I've impressive cards... do you wanna see? Haha!
March Hare.special: I’ll start with a card for myself. After all, it’s my unbirthday!

Cheshire Cat.name: Cheshire Cat
Cheshire Cat.talk_win: That's too bad... Are you going somewhere?
Cheshire Cat.talk_lose: It looks like you've found the direction you need to go...
Cheshire Cat.talk_thinking_1: Remember... we’re all mad here. I’m mad. You’re mad.
Cheshire Cat.talk_thinking_2: If you need to leave... I can show you the exit...

Caterpillar.name: Caterpillar
Caterpillar.talk_win: It seems like you haven't changed a bit...
Caterpillar.talk_thinking_2: Cough cough. I've good options, what about you?
Caterpillar.special: Oh my, the smoke is everywhere...

Humpty Dumpty.name: Humpty Dumpty
Humpty Dumpty.talk_win: Alice... what a stupid name! It must mean “loser,” haha!
Humpty Dumpty.talk_thinking_1: You think you're so great calling me an egg, huh? Just you wait!
Humpty Dumpty.special: Ignore the cracks, my shell still sturdy.

The Tweedles.name: The Tweedles
The Tweedles.talk_win: We, the TWEEDLE brothers, have won again!
The Tweedles.talk_lose: You win. We’ve no objection. Contrariwise.
The Tweedles.talk_thinking_1: Hey brother, this card is mine!

Dodo.name: Dodo
Dodo.talk_lose: I lost... You can keep the prize then...

Red Queen.name: Queen of Hearts
Red Queen.talk_lose: You may have won this battle... But you won’t win the war...
Red Queen.talk_thinking_1: Quiet! I'm thinking about my strategy!

Jabberwock.name: Jabberwock
Jabberwock.talk_win: Finally, I’ll be able to sharpen my fangs a little!
Jabberwock.talk_thinking_1: With this move, I'm going to tear you apart... hehe
Jabberwock.special: Alice! Best of three? What do you think?
